diagnostics.message: google_compute_router_peer.peer_0 references router appliance instances (router_appliance_instance = each.value.vm) via a different GCP API than the NCC spoke. BGP peers backed by router appliance instances require the VM to be registered as a linked router appliance instance on a Network Connectivity Center spoke first, so peer_0 must be created after google_network_connectivity_spoke.spoke-ra. There is no attribute reference connecting the two (the peer only sees var.router_appliances), so an explicit depends_on is needed; without it, parallel creation can make peer creation fail while the spoke is still being registered.
